Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
Balak_1: Midianite prophet who worked against Israel, son of Zippor (Numbers 22:2)
Omri_1: commander of the army and king over Israel (1 Kings 16:16)
Ahab_1: son of Omri and King of Israel (1 Kings 16:28)
